meta.name: offensive-deauth-disassoc
meta.description: Deauthentication and disassociation attacks against 802.11 networks — targeted single-client deauth for handshake capture, broadcast deauth for DoS (with authorization), action-frame attacks bypassing 802.11w (PMF), beacon flooding, mdk4 / aireplay-ng tooling, and rate-limit / PMF-aware operation. Use to coerce client reconnection (handshake capture, evil-twin roaming), as targeted DoS, or to test PMF posture.

copy.tagline: 对802.11网络执行认证解除与阻断攻击
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要进行Wi-Fi安全评估或测试PMF防护
copy.tagline_en: Perform deauthentication and disassociation attacks against 802.11 networks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to conduct Wi-Fi security assessments or test PMF protection

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能指导你执行针对 802.11 网络的去认证和解除关联攻击，包括单客户端去认证（用于捕获握手包）、广播去认证（DoS）、绕过 PMF 的动作帧攻击、信标洪水攻击等，并给出具体命令和参数。
howto.when: 当你需要测试无线网络安全性、捕获 WPA 握手包、或进行授权 DoS 测试时触发。

say.text: 帮我生成针对客户端 11:22:33:44:55:66 的单客户端去认证命令。
如何检查目标 AP 的 PMF 状态？
如果 PMF 要求启用，如何绕过？
say.note: Claude 会推荐使用 mdk4 的动作帧攻击。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can guide you through deauthentication and disassociation attacks against 802.11 networks, including single-client deauth (for handshake capture), broadcast deauth (DoS), action-frame attacks bypassing PMF, beacon flooding, and provides specific commands and parameters.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to test wireless network security, capture WPA handshakes, or perform authorized DoS testing.

say_en.text: Generate a single-client deauth command for client 11:22:33:44:55:66.
say_en.note: Claude will output an aireplay-ng command sending 5 deauth frames.

say_en.text: How to check the PMF status of a target AP?
say_en.note: Claude will explain using airodump-ng to view the PMF column.

say_en.text: How to bypass if PMF is required?
say_en.note: Claude will recommend using mdk4 action-frame attacks.
